purpose: Test whether a five-scalar-per-direction grouped-MLP6--7 gate learned on pristine FIT nouns/templates predicts absolute causal response on untouched HOLDOUT nouns and a third template without target endpoint calibration.
data_status: NEW_FIT_AND_UNTOUCHED_HOLDOUT_TEXT; authority frozen before any native or causal model outcome

binding_evidence.finding: Frozen 40-row authority has 32 FIT rows over two templates and 8 HOLDOUT rows over a third template, 48 disjoint one-token noun forms, 120 unique matched endpoints, and disjoint phase vocabularies.
Endpoint-calibrated gate shape transfers across two intervention-new constructions, leaving absolute amplitude generation open.
The distributed binary gate continuously and predictively steers grouped-source task use, licensing a harder zero-target-anchor prediction test.

novelty_audit: Authority searches for absolute-composition holdout, zero-target-endpoint transfer, pristine MLP6-7 composition, and background-amplitude holdout found no prior event.
Prior cross-cell tests use each target's q(empty),q(EAUW) endpoints. This test supplies neither HOLDOUT endpoint to the predictor and changes both noun vocabulary and template.
map: After a staged native-only capability pass, run the complete E/A/U/W-by-X lattice. On FIT only, average q(S) by direction, compute q0=q(empty) and exact four-factor Mobius/Shapley attributions a_E,a_A,a_U,a_W, then freeze q_hat(S)=q0+sum_{f in S}a_f. Apply those five scalars without refitting or target endpoints to every HOLDOUT q(S) mean. HOLDOUT uses disjoint nouns and only the unseen past/outside template.

predictions.pred_a_native_capability_license: Every registered phase/direction/template/role cell reaches at least 0.75 native accuracy; a candidate-scoped license is issued only on a complete pass.
predictions.pred_b_causal_instrument: The complete 40x2x16x2 lattice exists and all native replay, decomposition, no-op, and Mobius closures are at most 5e-5.
predictions.pred_c_fit_five_scalar_law: Within each FIT direction, the five-scalar additive law predicts the fourteen intermediate mean q(S) values with normalized MAE at most 0.15 and normalized maximum error at most 0.35.
predictions.pred_d_zero_anchor_holdout_prediction: For each HOLDOUT direction, without target endpoints, absolute MAE across all sixteen q(S) values is at most 0.04, MAE normalized by |holdout endpoint shift| is at most 0.30, and maximum normalized error is at most 0.60.
predictions.pred_e_factor_specificity_beats_uniform: On HOLDOUT, FIT factor-specific coefficients reduce aggregate squared error by at least 10% versus a uniform four-factor law using the same FIT q0 and endpoint shift.
predictions.pred_f_signed_gate_and_lexical_control: HOLDOUT opposite context shift is <=-0.05 for plural-to-singular and >=0.05 for singular-to-plural; maximum absolute HOLDOUT same-number lexical q(S) is at most 0.02.

null: Failure of d means the shared profile requires target endpoint calibration and is not yet a coefficient generator. Failure of e means direction-level amplitude, not factor identity, explains any transfer. Failure of f limits either sign stability or operational selectivity. A native or causal instrument failure invalidates all downstream claims. Do not tune coefficients or bars after HOLDOUT opens.
closed_claims: necessity outside the fixed L11H3 interface
global transfer beyond this frozen phase/template split
